faq.a: Round-trip flat fares start from ₹6,000 for Swift Dzire/Etios, ₹7,500 for Ertiga, ₹8,500 for Innova, ₹10,000 for Crysta, and ₹12,500 for 12-seater Tempo Traveller. All fares include car, fuel, tolls, AP permit, and driver allowance.

faq.q: Can we complete Tirupati Darshan from Chennai in one day?

faq.q: Can you arrange or bundle TTD ₹300 Darshan tickets?
faq.a: No. TTD mandates that devotees book tickets directly on ttdevasthanams.ap.gov.in using their personal Aadhaar or Passport. Travel operators cannot legally resell tickets. We time vehicle pickup to match your darshan slot.

faq.q: What if we don't have online TTD ₹300 tickets booked in advance?
faq.a: You can get free Slotted Sarva Darshan (SSD) tokens directly at Tirupati counters with your original Aadhaar. For SSD darshan, we recommend our 2 Days / 1 Night package.

faq.q: Are tolls, permits, and parking included in the fare?
faq.a: Yes, 100% included. You never pay extra cash on the road for highway tolls, AP border permit, or temple parking.

faq.q: What is the official dress code for Tirupati Darshan?
faq.a: Men must wear dhoti with shirt or kurta pyjama. Women must wear saree or chudidhar with dupatta. Western wear, jeans, and t-shirts are strictly prohibited.

faq.q: Is Sri Padmavathi Ammavari Temple (Tiruchanur) included?
faq.a: Yes. A dedicated stop at Tiruchanur is included before returning to Chennai.

faq.q: Is this package convenient for senior citizens and families?
faq.a: Yes. Clean AC vehicles with doorstep pickup and drop close to the queue complex. Drivers assist with luggage and counters.
